items.title: Anteris Reports 30-Day Outcomes for Medium-Size DurAVR THV in EMBARK Early Feasibility Study at TCT 2026
items.title_zh: Anteris公司在TCT 2026公布DurAVR经导管主动脉瓣中号瓣膜EMBARK早期可行性研究30天结果
items.summary_zh: 2026年11月1日,Anteris Technologies在TCT 2026大会上由Azeem Latib医生公布其DurAVR经导管主动脉瓣系统中号瓣膜在EMBARK早期可行性研究中22例中等瓣环重度主动脉瓣狭窄患者(瓣环面积492±38mm²)的30天结果。有效瓣口面积由基线0.8±0.2cm²提升至2.64±0.19cm²,平均跨瓣压差由45.5±11.7mmHg降至6.17±1.40mmHg,无中度以上瓣周漏、无瓣膜相关死亡,100%患者未出现中重度人工瓣膜-患者不匹配。该中号瓣膜数据现已纳入公司正在入组的全球关键性研究PARADIGM。
items.summary_en: On November 1, 2026 at TCT 2026, Anteris Technologies reported 30-day outcomes from the EMBARK early feasibility study of its medium-size DurAVR transcatheter heart valve, presented by Azeem Latib, MD, in 22 patients with severe aortic stenosis and medium annuli (annulus area 492±38 mm²). Effective orifice area improved from 0.8±0.2 cm² at baseline to 2.64±0.19 cm², mean gradient fell from 45.5±11.7 mmHg to 6.17±1.40 mmHg, with no moderate-or-greater paravalvular leak, no valve-related mortality, and 100% freedom from moderate/severe prosthesis-patient mismatch. The medium-size valve is now part of Anteris' ongoing global pivotal PARADIGM trial.
